3105 Yaupon Road
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$295,000, 2,570 SF, MLS# 560575

Duplex Multi-Family Home in Copperas Cove – Great Investment Opportunity!

This duplex is an investor's dream! Both units are already occupied by tenants, which means you can start generating income right away with little to no vacancy time. Each side is spacious and thoughtfully designed to appeal to long-term tenants, with a layout that provides all the essentials for comfortable living. Whether you’re looking to expand your rental portfolio or need an investment property in a high-demand rental market, this duplex has you covered.

Location:
Situated in a quiet, established neighborhood, this property offers easy access to everything Copperas Cove has to offer. Close to schools, parks, shopping centers, and Fort Cavazos, this duplex is in a prime location for renters, making it even more appealing to potential tenants. Commuting to nearby Killeen or Fort Cavazos is a breeze, adding extra convenience for military families or professionals in the area.

Investment Highlights:
The multi-family setup offers flexibility for an owner-occupier who wants to live in one unit and rent the other.

Copperas Cove is a growing market with a high demand for rental properties, making this duplex a smart choice for the future
Don’t Miss Out!

This duplex at 3105 Yaupon Cir is a opportunity in Copperas Cove’s bustling real estate market. With tenant-occupied units and 2,570 sq ft of total space, this is a must-see for any savvy investor. Contact us today to schedule a showing or to get more information on this incredible property!
